name: foyer-and-dining-connection
caption: From the foyer, the dining room sits to the left and the office to the right, with the family spaces beyond.

name: kitchen-detail
caption: The sculpted hood, patterned backsplash and illuminated upper cabinets give the kitchen another layer of detail.

name: servery
caption: White cabinetry and the curved tile pattern continue through the servery, connecting the breakfast area to the dining room.

name: powder-room
caption: White vanity drawers, a wall-mounted faucet and natural light give the tucked-away powder room a calm finish.

name: laundry-room
caption: A counter above the appliances, integrated storage and a geometric backsplash bring the same attention to detail to the laundry room.

name: ensuite
caption: A freestanding bath, double vanity and broad mirror bring light and openness to the ensuite.

name: door-hardware
caption: Textured lever handles and tall backplates add another layer of detail to the panelled doors.

name: rear-elevation
caption: Tall, individually framed windows carry the family room's light and privacy strategy through to the rear elevation.
